text: If you’ve been waiting for a good fall afternoon, Monday is delivering: clear skies, comfortable low humidity, and 57 in Burlington by late morning. We should still climb a few more degrees, topping out near 62, with sunshine holding through sunset at 6:01. The evening stays quiet and clear, but temperatures will slide toward a chilly 42 overnight, so bring a layer if you’re out late. Tuesday keeps the sunshine but feels cooler, with a high around 56. Enjoy the rest of today for a walk or ride, then plan on a jacket after dark.
